# Dependencies for pybullet_navigation.py
# Install:  python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
#
# Run:
# 1) cd to this folder (same level as urdf/), e.g.  cd e:\RobotDog_Project\env
# 2) (Recommended) Python 3.9+ venv, then install packages above.
# 3) Run:  python pybullet_navigation.py
#
# Notes:
# - Loads urdf/diff_drive_2wheel.urdf - run from the correct working directory.
# - __main__ uses gui=False (PyBullet DIRECT, no window). For GUI and keys
#   (W/S/A/D, R, Q), use RL_Env(gui=True) in the .py file.
# - Logs/CSV/images go under experiment/ when you run.

pybullet>=3.2.5
numpy>=1.21.0
matplotlib>=3.5.0
